subject: Re: Kickoff: symbolic regression — status + generalization risk
body:
Hi both,

Status:

- Tereza hit the mid-May milestone: NN training reproduced end to end from train.tfrecords, eval on eval.csv (4,095 expressions) tracks the release's curves.
- Early constraint-conditioning numbers from Yusuf on the holdout tiers: with leading-power constraints supplied, success rate on holdout_m_leq_4 is strong and roughly doubles the unconstrained baseline. The story weakens with complexity: on holdout_m_5 (1,000 expressions) the constrained model still leads clearly, but on holdout_m_6 the gap narrows and absolute success is low for both. Semantic novelty stays healthy — we're not just memorizing training expressions.
- Service wrapper: grammar caps working; a 40-symbol customer vocabulary keeps generation tractable.

Risk for the readout: if customer formulas skew toward M=6-level complexity, v1 will underdeliver. Suggest we position v1 for M<=5-class problems explicitly and say so on the label.

Leilani
